title: Orchestrated Minimum Capacity Conformance and Surge Shedder
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Introduce a policy that ensures per-pool minimum capacity conformance and a surge shedder to dampen microbursts; adds telemetry for utilization drift and a new config knob for conservative headroom. No API changes; rollout via canary and staged config flags.
description:
Motivation: Dedicated fleets sometimes violate per-tenant minimum capacity SLAs during rapid churn and microburst events. This leads to transient request throttling and customer-observed throughput drops. This PR introduces an orchestrated 'Minimum Capacity Conformance' policy that enforces reserved minima across pools and a complementary 'Surge Shedder' that proactively sheds non-essential microburst traffic to protect committed throughput.

What changed (high level): Added a policy reconciliation loop that periodically computes per-pool conformance deltas and emits corrective allocation requests to the provisioner. Implemented a soft 'surge shedder' that observes short-timescale occupancy spikes and signals request-routing to gracefully shed best-effort traffic (low-priority routes, background workloads) while preserving reserved capacity for committed tenants. Added telemetry for utilization divergence (expected vs actual reserve fulfillment) and a conformance audit log.

Why this is safe: The conformance controller only issues corrective allocation intents — it does not force immediate evictions. The surge shedder is conservative by default (configurable thresholds); it prefers redirecting to cheaper model variants or applying rate-limits to non-critical routes. All knobs are opt-in behind the dedicated.conformance.enabled and dedicated.surge_shedder.enabled feature flags initially.

Checklist:
- [x] Conformance controller + reconciliation loop implemented
- [x] Surge shedder logic + routing hooks implemented
- [x] Unit + integration tests covering typical churn and microburst patterns
- [x] Telemetry metrics + audit events wired to metrics backend and logs
- [x] Docs: operator-facing guide and rollout plan
- [x] Feature flags and conservative defaults set for staged rollout

Testing performed: Local unit tests; integration test harness that simulates tenant churn and simultaneous bursty arrivals (test/integration/autoscale_conformance_test.go). Ran end-to-end on staging with 3 canary pools for 48 hours: observed conformance violations drop by ~85% and committed throughput held steady under synthetic microbursts. Performed a perf check: p99 tail increased ~1.8% for best-effort requests while protecting reserved throughput.

Rollout plan: Merge to main, enable feature flags in staging, monitor conformance metrics and audit logs for 72h. If stable, enable on 10% of dedicated clusters for 48h and then ramp. Feature flags allow immediate rollback.

Backward compatibility: No public API changes. Config defaults conservative; existing autoscaler behavior preserved when flags off.

Operational notes: New metrics: dedicated.conformance.delta, dedicated.conformance.violation_count, dedicated.surge_shedder.invocations, dedicated.utilization.divergence (all exported to console dashboards). Added a small config surface: min_conformance_window_seconds, surge_shedder_threshold_qps, burst_decay_half_life_seconds. Operators should watch violation_count and surge_shedder.invocations during ramp.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) add conformance controller and reconciliation loop (pkg/autoscaler/min_capacity_conformance.go), 2) implement surge shedder and routing hooks (pkg/autoscaler/surge_shedder.go + pkg/routing/shedder_hook.go), 3) telemetry, tests and docs (pkg/telemetry/utilization_exporter.go, test/integration/autoscale_conformance_test.go, docs/dedicated/capacity-conformance.md). Commit messages include short rationale and test links.

merge_summary: Squash merged by Ravi Patel after approvals (3 reviewers). Merge commit includes final changelog and staged feature flag defaults. Deployed to staging by CI; canary rollout scheduled. See deploy run: CI/build-2026-03-08-12:34:56 (successful).
notes: This PR intentionally leaves the follow-up work to convert the fixed conformance window into an adaptive percentile heuristic (ENG-4123). We flagged potential interactions with the allocation backpressure controller; will observe metrics during canary.
short_description: Enforce minimum reserved capacity and introduce conservative microburst shedding with telemetry and operator docs.
